coc-keeper v1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial public release.
- Provides workflow for running Call of Cthulhu (COC 7th) TTRPG as Keeper, including step-by-step preparation, gameplay, and summary processes.
- Details file structure, recovery mechanisms, and strict rules for information disclosure and scene management.
- Integrates support for dice rolling and character card management via scripts.
- Enforces narrative discipline to prevent spoilers and ensure immersive, player-driven storytelling.
- Supports KP (Keeper) personality profiles to enhance the authenticity of the game hosting experience.
